# Fonts

The Text tool's built-in fonts (T), Regular and Bold each:

* `NotoSans-*.ttf` — Noto Sans
* `NotoSerif-*.ttf` — Noto Serif
* `NotoSansThai-*.ttf` — Noto Sans Thai (Thai letters; others come from Noto Sans)
* `NotoSansSymbols-Regular.ttf`, `NotoSansSymbols2-Regular.ttf` — Noto Sans Symbols / Symbols 2 (♥ ☺ ★ ♪…: the
  Text panel's Symbols grid, and the fallback for symbols a font hasn't got; Regular only)
